headline: Tata Group firms
summary: Tata Group-backed companies' stocks fell up to 5.95% on Wednesday, losing about Rs 46,000 crore in market value. N. Chandrasekaran said he would not seek reappointment as Tata Sons chairman when his term ends in February 2027.
why: Tata Sons is the holding company at the centre of the Tata Group, a large Indian conglomerate whose listed companies span autos, steel, IT services and more. Leadership changes at the holding company can affect investor confidence across the group's listed shares.
why_moved: Shares fell after N. Chandrasekaran said he would not seek reappointment as Tata Sons chairman when his current term expires in February 2027, creating uncertainty over group leadership.
